title: After 10 years of wanting to make my own card game, I finally built it
author: ShenZuBro
selftext:
I've always loved card games like Pokemon, Blackjack, War, DnD, Gwent, and others. This was like 10 years ago, and I always wanted to make my own card game. But finding good artists back then wasn't easy. I spent hours scouring deviantart and pixiv until I finally found someone. Unfortunately, life happened, and I abandoned the project....until AI dropped.

So here I present to you, TSI: War & Peace - which is a free tactical card game with both single-player and multiplayer modes. **Play here:** [https://www.stierideas.com/wpgame](https://www.stierideas.com/wpgame)

Currently you can play two factions: humans and beasts, and more are being planned in the future. 

It's free to play, with no subscription required.

The UI and artwork still needs a bit of polish, but I'm happy that something I've imagined for a decade is finally playable.

I'm looking for people to test it out, especially the multiplayer! So share it with your friends if tactical cards games are your thing!

If the game gains some traction, I'd love to collaborate with real artists to improve the visuals and maybe even develop an expansion pack, if it's in the cards (no pun intended).

Would appreciate any feedback, especially on gameplay and bugs.
